In the total number of units of the products sold in 2020 is 20% more than that in 2019, and the sales distribution of all the products remain the same, then what will be the difference between the number of units of products E and D sold in 2020?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total products sold in 2020 = 22500 × 120/100

⇒ 22500 × 6/5 = 27000 units

Now difference between E and D = 165.6 - 90 = 75.6° 

So, Difference in units = 27000 × 75.6/360 = 5670

**∴ Required answer is 5670**

questions.question:
The pie chart given below shows the number of employees in 6 different companies. The total number of employees in all these 6 companies 15840. The number of employees in a particular company is shown in terms of degree with respect to the total number of employees in all these 6 companies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a63ce739ce11143445c96157fbfd6395c1801194ea4d62080b571c97e735eda5.png] 

J1 = The total number of employees in P, Q, S, T, and U.

J2 = The difference between the total number of employees in P and Q and the total number of employees in T and U.

What is the value of (J1 + J2)?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

J1 = The total number of employees in P, Q, S, T, and U.

77° + 103° + 40° + 81° + 20° = 321°

J2 = The difference between the total number of employees in P and Q and the total number of employees in T and U.

P + Q = 77° + 103° = 180°

T + U = 40° + 20° = 60°

J2 = 180° - 60° = 120°

(J1 + J2) = 321° + 120° = 441°

360° = 15840

1° = 44

441° = 44 × 441 = 19404

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**

questions.question:
Study the pie chart and answer the questions that follows.

The number of people applying for a passport from a city was monitored, and it was found that the numbers (in multiples of hundreds) during the first five months of 2019 were as follows: January (M1) - 248, February (M2) - 134, March (M3) - 162, April (M4) - 94, May (M5) - 72. These have been represented through the given pie chart.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8a9f71522c055b4d8e98bc6c833b9ba35b788451d0ba9460089923c1ac92f6e.png] 

If the number of people during M2 and M5 had, respectively, been 50% less and 50% more what has been presented in the pie chart, then what would be the central angle (nearest to degree) of the sector corresponding to M5?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Total 360° represents the entire pie chart.

Number of People at sector M2 after the decrement = 134 - 134 × 50% = 67

Number of People at sector M5 after the increment = 72 + 72 × 50% = 108

Total number of people in all sectors = 248 + 67 + 162 + 94 + 108 = 679

Hence, the central angle of the sector corresponding to M5 = {108 over 679} × 360 ≈ 57°

**∴ The central angle of the sector corresponding to M5 is 57°.**

The following pie chart chows the various expenses of a family, as percentages of total expenditure of the family during a period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a7ce93b0dec096ef145259e9daedac13392769aea9645b82a5f5439930d443d.png] 

If the total expenditure of the family during that period was ₹2,00,000, then find the amount spent on medical expenses.
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total expenditure = Rs. 200000

Percentage of expense on medical = 20%

Amount spent on medical expenses = 20/100 × 200000 = Rs. 40000 

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**

questions.question:
The following pie chart shows the sectors representing the shares of the number of lights manufactured in a given year by each of six different factories in terms of the central angles (in degrees) with respect to the total number of lights manufactured in that year by all the six factories taken together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea8fe83c19dfe1a2e4f657609ab06702ebc9a5281c2da13efb7311a11d3b1065.png] 

If the total number of lights manufactured in that year by the 6 factories taken together is 1840, then what is the difference between the numbers of lights manufactured by F5 and F1?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The following pie chart shows the sectors representing the shares of the number of lights manufactured in a given year by each of six different factories in terms of the central angles (in degrees) with respect to the total number of lights manufactured in that year by all the six factories taken together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea8fe83c19dfe1a2e4f657609ab06702ebc9a5281c2da13efb7311a11d3b1065.png] 

Total lights Manufactured = 1840

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Lights manufactured by F5

Percentage = ((45°)/(360°)) × 100

⇒ P = 0.125 × 100 = 12.5%

Total lights by F5 = 12.5% of 1840

⇒ 12.5% × 1840

⇒ 0.125 × 1840 = 230

Lights manufactured by F1

Percentage = ((27°)/(360°)) × 100

⇒ P = 0.075 × 100 = 7.5%

Total lights by F1 = 7.5% of 1840

⇒ 7.5% × 1840

⇒ 0.075 × 1840 = 138

Now the difference between the numbers of lights manufactured by F5 and F1 = 230 - 138 = 92 lights

**∴ The difference between the numbers of lights manufactured by F5 and F1 is of 92 lights.**

47
